question: What cosmic integration is achieved when the sixfold great installation is performed?
premises: The rite involves six causes, sixfold selfhood, and the joining of the thirty-six principles.
When the sixfold great installation is performed, this integration is enacted.
The whole universe is drawn into that integration.
inference: The sixfold great installation integrates the thirty-six principles and powerfully unites the universe within the rite.
uncertainties: The compound ṣaṭkāraṇaṣaḍātmatvāt is dense; the gloss follows the most direct reading.
plain_english: Because of the six causes, the sixfold selfhood, and the joining of the thirty-six principles, when the sixfold great installation is performed, this whole universe is powerfully brought into unity.
